problem: It addresses the difficulty of converting unstructured data formats like lists and tables into the structured, property-based format required for Obsidian Bases.
summary: Basify converts selected lists, tables, and task lists into structured Obsidian notes and bases, transforming unstructured data into individual, property-rich notes.
